author: Nerise, a diver of the Ascadian shore
pages:
Dear brother,

The kollop beds off the point are good this year. I bring up forty a day and one in thirty has a pearl in it, small but clean. Old Fevyn pays fair for them.

Don't tell mother, but I dove past the drop-off yesterday where the black rock mounds are, and something big moved inside one of them. I came straight up. I'm sticking to the shallows now. I promise.

Your loving sister
